senses.gloss:
ऋच् r. 6th cl. (ऋचति)
 1. To praise.
 2. To cover, to screen.

ऋच् f. (ऋक्)
 1. Rik or Rig Veda, one of the four principal religious
books of the Hindus.
 2. A stanza of a prayer or hymn of the Rig
Veda.
 3. A mantra, a magical invocation, a mystical prayer. E.
ऋच् to praise, affix क्विप्, celebrating the praises of the gods.
